definitions.explanation: Something that can be done without much difficulty. A formal, written-style word.

examples.japanese: {容易|ようい}なことではない。
{問題|もんだい}の{解決|かいけつ}は{容易|ようい}ではなかった。
examples.english: Solving the problem was not easy.

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}{失|うしな}った{信頼|しんらい}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}すのは{容易|ようい}ではない。
examples.english: Regaining trust once lost is not easy.

notes:
{容易|ようい} is a na-adjective meaning "easy" in a formal register.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {容易|ようい}な + noun
- Adverbial: {容易|ようい}に (easily)
- Negative: {容易|ようい}ではない

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容易|ようい}に{想像|そうぞう}できる (easy to imagine)
- {容易|ようい}に{手|て}に{入|はい}る (easy to obtain)
- {容易|ようい}なことではない (no easy matter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {容易|ようい} vs. {簡単|かんたん} vs. {易|やさ}しい: All mean "easy," but {容易|ようい} is the most formal and appears mainly in written language. {簡単|かんたん} is the neutral, everyday word. {易|やさ}しい is versatile but also means "gentle" or "kind."

USAGE:
{容易|ようい} frequently appears in negative constructions ({容易|ようい}ではない, {容易|ようい}に〜ない). The adverbial form {容易|ようい}に is common in writing. Note the homophone {用意|ようい} (preparation), which is a different word.
